profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer, Omnichannel Retail (Self-Checkout US & Canada) at Michaels
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer skilled in backend, mobile, cloud engineering with deployment pipelines in micro-services architecture. Experienced in building machine learning solutions and robotics.

Masters in Computer Science - University of Texas at Arlington, Dallas Texas [Class of Fall 2020]

company.name: The University of Texas at Arlington

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Implemented ROS seamlessly into the Jetson TX2, an advanced NVIDIA AI platform tailored for self-driving car models. Leveraging data inputs from LiDAR and ZED stereo cameras, we meticulously crafted solutions achieving an impressive 84% accuracy rate.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cactus -  Voice Comm SDK 
* Tech: (Python, Go, Node.js, FreeSWITCH, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD)
* Worked diligently on developing a client SDK for cloud infrastructure deployment, specializing in routing SIP/VOIP calls.
* Spearheaded the creation of automated CI/CD pipelines, optimizing the build, testing, and deployment processes.
* Actively managed and enhanced the cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), contributing to improved performance and reliability.
* Pioneered the deployment of Docker containers for microservices, streamlining internal workflows, enhancing scalability, and optimizing network efficiency.

Omniengage - Chat Bot
* Tech: (Slack API, GCP App Engine, Cloud SQL)
* Designed and constructed chatbots to facilitate seamless customer-agent communication via Slack.

Crypticup - Mobile App
* Tech: (Swift, Java, Python, Sumo Logic, Firebase)
* Led the refinement and enhancement of mobile app design and features across four major releases, resulting in a remarkable 40% reduction in app crashes.
* Revamped existing crash reporting and logging mechanisms, significantly improving debugging and troubleshooting capabilities across the entire project.

positions.title: Co-Founder and Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Guided a web application project from its initial prototype stage to successful production deployment, demonstrating leadership and technical prowess throughout the development lifecycle.
* Championed a culture of continuous improvement, consistently identifying and implementing enhancements to the application's features and functionality.
* Implemented robust automation processes that effectively addressed and resolved communication challenges, leading to a remarkable 50% month-over-month growth in project efficiency and effectiveness.

positions.title: Lead Application Developer
positions.description:
* Successfully led the migration of an existing iOS project to Swift, enhancing both the app's performance and design.
* Spearheaded a comprehensive redesign effort, ensuring a seamless and performant user experience across multiple mobile platforms.
* Overhauled the crash reporting and logging systems to address end-point authentication issues, resulting in a remarkable 20% reduction in app crashes.
* These improvements had a direct impact on business growth, contributing to a 40% increase in the premium user base.

positions.title: Engineering
positions.description:
* Innovatively designed and implemented a single-page administrative dashboard, providing real-time monitoring capabilities for business requests and inventory management.
* Contributed to the evolution of API design and implementation, transitioning from a traditional architecture to a Single Page Application (SPA) style. This transformation significantly improved checkout processing speed and fostered more engaging interactions with customers.
